title: Difference of two top-dimensional density currents and its mass bound
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, X, Pc ∈ D_n(ℝ^n) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), and u, v : ℝ^n → ℝ Lebesgue integrable. Write ω_e(x) := ω(x)(e_0, …, e_m) with e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, and assume X(ω) = ∫ u ω_e dx and Pc(ω) = ∫ v ω_e dx for every ω ∈ D^n(ℝ^n). Then there is S ∈ D_n(ℝ^n) with X(ω) − Pc(ω) = S(ω) for every ω and M(S) ≤ ∫⁻ |u − v| dx.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)) (u v : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), Integrable u → Integrable v → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), X ω = ∫ x, u x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), Pc ω = ∫ x, v x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), (∀ ω, X ω - Pc ω = S ω) ∧ S.mass ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - v x|
